Sending company data to ChatGPT is a confidentiality concern because any data or code sent to the platform is likely to be used for subsequent training, which raises issues regarding the confidentiality of corporate data and the potential for data leakage. This can lead to the unauthorized exposure or misuse of sensitive information.

In response to the incident where its engineers leaked sensitive data while using ChatGPT, Samsung banned the use of this generative AI internally and plans to develop its own AI.
